Automated translation (refer to source for accuracy)

The Children's Library will close temporarily for facility repairs during the following dates.

We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your understanding and cooperation.

【Closure Period (all day)】

Dec 4, 2025 (Reiwa 8) through Jan 15, 2026 (Reiwa 9)

【Actions during the closure】

• Reading inside the Children's Library, borrowing books, and returning books are not available.

• For those who reserved materials: please pick them up at the Municipal Library instead of the Children's Library.

• The book drop box remains available during the closure period.

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-lib.jp/calendar/post-85.html
